verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a Kushki docs section titled "Webhooks para tarjeta presente". That shows first-party webhook support for card-present payments, but the pack contains no detail on how to register endpoints, which event types exist, or how payloads are delivered. missing for 10: webhook registration/subscription docs, event catalog across payment methods (online cards, refunds, subscriptions, payouts), payload/signature verification details, retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
